text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear? You know, about the
scrimmage this weekend.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Right, the one Narita Taishin's going to
race in. "Another chance to
see what she's
really made of," was it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone at the academy knows about the
scrimmage thanks to Winning Ticket and
her days-long spree of shouting all around

campus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the reactions to the big news are
mixed.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is precise, and Winning
Ticket runs like a rocket. And
it isn't just them...
The other racers have been training
just as hard.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
There's no way Taishin's winning this.
I just
hope she doesn't overdo it
and get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try approaching the glum-looking racer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's close with Biwa Hayahide and
Winning Ticket, so she probably
knows
more about their much-talked-about
abilities than most.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Who asked you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks grim, but I still remember that
video—her fiery sprint down
the
homestretch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? Who do you think you're
talking to?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You mean I'm already a disgrace? So I
should just lose without making
a damn
fuss?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That's insane...
If I let the big runners like
Hayahide get ahead, I'll
never catch up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I don't get it... What are you getting all bothered for?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure if she really got my advice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it's too late now—the gates are
opening!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clank!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Wow... Biwa Hayahide's off in excellent
form. She's got a nice
position in the front.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket too. Must be in a good
mood 'cause she knows so many of the
racers!
I can't wait to see her in the last
stretch!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Narita Taishin's way in back... I
wonder if she tripped up her
start.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Crap,
I can't take this. The front's getting
blocked off... It's like a
wall.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"You don't need to get caught up in the
fight for position."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Take it slow in the beginning."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! I mean, if you don't fight, you can
win!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! I mean, if you don't fight, you can
win!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"With your breakaway speed, you can
overtake anyone!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"With your breakaway speed, you can
overtake anyone!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Fine.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Here it is, the last corner! Ah, Winning
Ticket's coming up fast!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAGH! FULL SPEED AHEEEAD!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh, as I predicted, Winning Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
It's Biwa Hayahide and Winning Ticket!
Will it come down to a fight
between
those two powerhouses?!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Wait! From the outside!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haaaaargh!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin?! Look at that burst of
speed!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(This is it—don't lose focus! Keep your
eyes on me! Watch me do
this!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (I'm Narita Taishin, a trueborn racer!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's even more focused than in the
video... Like a blade forged from
all her
willpower and perseverance, she cuts
straight to the front.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone holds their breath as it ends,
and Narita Taishin wins a close
finish. Following
her are Biwa Hayahide and Winning
Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's more than enough to make her full
potential known—a truly
stunning race.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Well,
looks like I still have some studying
to do. How could I misjudge
a racer like
her?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh! I looost!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Knock it off.
I can't deal with your painful
whining so soon after a
race.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But, but, but! I went all out! I really
thought I was gonna be all like,
"Yay, I
won," like always!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But...
I just couldn't keep up with you! I'm
still burning with
excitement!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's why! We should definitely, no, ABSOLUTELY race again with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ticket...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haha. No thanks, I can't take anymore of
your screaming, dummy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I believe we've communicated our reasons
for wanting to help well
enough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hayahide...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
None of us can afford to lose our most
powerful rivals here. We're in
this
together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Enough with the touchy-feely talk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The commotion dies down, and Narita
Taishin hesitantly walks over to
me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Um... Hey.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So, Ticket put words in your mouth the other day, but uh... If you really, um, y'know... You can say it now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
NO, you idiot! I'll kick your ass! I mean,
whether you want to...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Sure.
